note: Hand-compiled from official announcements. 'deals' = month in which a deal, framework or agreement on tariffs was first announced by both governments: UK (Economic Prosperity Deal general terms, 8 May 2025); Vietnam (2 Jul 2025; framework joint statement 26 Oct 2025); Indonesia (joint statement 22 Jul 2025; Agreement on Reciprocal Trade, ART); Philippines (22 Jul 2025); Japan (22 Jul 2025; implemented by EO 14345, 4 Sep 2025); EU (Turnberry, 27 Jul 2025; joint statement 21 Aug 2025; FR 2025-18660); South Korea (30 Jul 2025; joint fact sheet 13 Nov 2025; FR 2025-21940); Pakistan (30-31 Jul 2025); Thailand (framework) and Cambodia, Malaysia (ARTs) (Kuala Lumpur, 26 Oct 2025); Switzerland and Liechtenstein (framework 14 Nov 2025; FR 2025-23316); Argentina, Ecuador, Guatemala, El Salvador (frameworks 13 Nov 2025; ARTs signed Jan-Mar 2026, USTR); Taiwan (MOU 15 Jan 2026, ART 12 Feb 2026; FR 2026-10571); India (joint statement on an interim framework, 6 Feb 2026, whitehouse.gov); Bangladesh (ART signed 9 Feb 2026, USTR); Jordan (ART signed 21 Jul 2026, USTR). Most are frameworks or agreements whose tariff terms were partly overtaken when the Supreme Court ended the IEEPA tariffs on 20 Feb 2026. 'response' as of 13 Oct 2026: retaliated = imposed counter-tariffs on US goods (China from Feb 2025, State Council Tariff Commission; Canada from 4 Mar 2025, largely lifted 1 Sep 2025, new counter-tariffs of 15-50% from 8 Sep 2026, Department of Finance Canada, 25 Aug 2026); deal = as above (the EU also adopted countermeasures on EUR 93 bn of US goods, Implementing Regulation 2025/1564, but has kept them suspended); punished = punitive tariff and no deal (Brazil: +40% from 6 Aug 2025, EO 14323; Section 301 25% from 22 Jul 2026, USTR FR 2026-14542). Not coloured: no deal and no retaliation, e.g. Mexico (talks under the USMCA review) or most of Africa and Latin America.
